slides.say: Copying a prop into state looks harmless. It is a classic bug.
State is only initialized on the first render. If the parent later passes red instead of blue, color stays blue.
Use the prop directly. Want a shorter name? Use a constant. It cannot fall out of sync.

slides.text: Want to ignore updates on purpose? Name it initial… or default…
slides.say: Only mirror a prop when you want to ignore its updates. Then name it initial or default, so readers know new values are ignored.
